gates.label: Live variant passes the pre-registered backtest gates
gates.action: Run the Backtest workflow so reports are stamped with the current evidence_hash.
gates.acceptance: reports/provenance.json matches evidence_hash, is < 45 days old, and the live variant passes G1-G3.

gates.label: Beats buy-and-hold of the same universe AND a momentum-30 replica per unit of drawdown (hold-out)
gates.action: Rerun the Backtest workflow, then judge the hold-out. Frozen numbers show C0 Calmar 0.42 against momentum-30 1.05 and equal-weight 0.83.
gates.acceptance: C0 hold-out Calmar >= every same-universe benchmark. On the frozen numbers it is not: do not expect these points.

gates.label: Survivorship-free backtest passes the same gates (attested)
gates.owner: Operator attestation of a real-world fact
gates.action: Build a point-in-time membership file (index reconstitution notices) and delisted-stock prices; set EDGE_PIT_UNIVERSE; rerun Backtest; then attest.
gates.depends_on: External data (NSE index notices, bhavcopy for delisted names) that this environment cannot fetch.
gates.acceptance: reports/pit_acceptance.json passes (coverage >= 95%, departed stocks with prices) AND the rerun passes the same gates AND attestations.json is set by the operator.
gates.detail: survivorship bias remains: no point-in-time membership file (EDGE_PIT_UNIVERSE); results are survivorship-biased (attestations.json: survivorship_free_backtest_passed also required)

gates.label: At least 100 closed forward signals
gates.action: Run the daily screen and ledger for months. No shortcut exists.

gates.label: At least 182 days of forward record
gates.action: Wait. The clock starts at the first evidence-eligible signal recorded under the fail-closed pipeline.
gates.acceptance: >= 182 days since the first eligible signal.

gates.label: Forward expectancy (closed + open) has a 95% CI lower bound above 0
gates.acceptance: Month-clustered 95% CI lower bound of forward expectancy (closed + open) > 0.
gates.detail: needs 100+ closed signals and 182+ days first (have 3, 8)

gates.label: Forward expectancy is not clearly below the backtest design-period figure
gates.acceptance: Forward CI upper bound >= backtest design-period average R.
gates.detail: needs 100+ closed signals and 182+ days first (have 3, 8)

gates.label: At least 30 live fills with slippage within 2x the model
gates.action: Needs real fills, therefore a live trial, which needs explicit operator authorisation and every safety gate. Not available in paper mode.
gates.acceptance: >= 30 real fills in live_fills.csv with slippage within 2x the model.

gates.label: Forward record includes a >=10% Nifty drawdown, rules followed (attested)
gates.owner: Operator attestation of a real-world fact
gates.action: Needs a >= 10% Nifty drawdown to occur during the forward record, with the rules followed. Cannot be created or backdated.
gates.acceptance: Operator attests market_stress_observed after it has actually happened.

gates.label: Operations healthy: no health FAIL and no data lag
gates.action: Run the Daily Stock Screen on a day the vendor has published the official bars; health must be OK/WARN with trusted data and consistent artefacts.
gates.depends_on: Vendor publishes daily bars; Yahoo reachable from Actions.
gates.acceptance: health OK/WARN, data_quality TRUSTED, no inconsistencies.
gates.detail: health DEGRADED/FAIL earns no operations credit

gates.label: Risk limits within safe bounds (risk/trade <= 1%, open risk <= 3%, position <= 25%)

u1_note: U1 excluded from the near-term ceiling: the frozen hold-out comparison shows C0 below momentum-30 and equal-weight on Calmar.
